risk_summary: The excerpt discloses material liquidity pressure, including a $1.6 million net loss, $11.1 million of operating cash outflow, sharply higher inventory, delayed shipments, supplier negotiations, and reliance on $5.0 million of additional loans. Management projects sufficient liquidity for twelve months, but this conclusion depends on revenue growth, working-capital reductions, and successful execution of contingency measures amid continuing supply-chain and government-funding risks.
